def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # find rectangle color and bounds
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    rect=[c for c in cnt if c not in (0,1,8)]
    rect=rect[0]
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==rect]
    r0=min(i for i,j in cells); r1=max(i for i,j in cells)
    c0=min(i for i,j in cells); c1=max(j for i,j in cells)
    mark=set((i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] in (1,8))
    o=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]!=0: continue
            up = j>=c0 and j<=c1 and i<r0 and not any(m[0]<r0 and m[1]==j for m in mark)
            dn = j>=c0 and j<=c1 and i>r1 and not any(m[0]>r1 and m[1]==j for m in mark)
            lf = i>=r0 and i<=r1 and j<c0 and not any(m[1]<c0 and m[0]==i for m in mark)
            rt = i>=r0 and i<=r1 and j>c1 and not any(m[1]>c1 and m[0]==i for m in mark)
            if up or dn or lf or rt: o[i][j]=rect
    return o
